The bar is the heading and the row of links — the first two lines of the document. BMX has no attribute syntax, so the stylesheet reaches them by position rather than by class: .bmx > h1 is the brand, the first p is the links. Brittle on purpose, to show where the seam is — ::: nav is how you name the region instead, and your framework decides what it renders as.

The content is markdown doing what markdown does: a heading, a paragraph, a list, a quote, a link. The cards are list items and the thumbnails are CSS gradients — BMX has no image syntax (SPEC.md §7).

One document, 15 lines, and no HTML anywhere — the bar, the search box, the buttons, the cards, the quote, the price. A document and a stylesheet, which is what every page has.
